entries.name: Vernon Powell Woodward

expected_cases.charges: Freedom Ride participation — challenging segregation in interstate transportation facilities, Jackson, late July 1961; exact arrest date unresolved.
expected_cases.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected_cases.sentence: Arrested 1961-07-30. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

case.charges: Breach of the peace - Episcopal Prayer Pilgrimage at the Jackson Trailways terminal
case.sentence: Sentenced to four months in jail and a $200 fine. Released on appeal bond September 19, 1961 after six elapsed days in custody. The later appeal was not continuous incarceration.

entries.rationale: Arsenault names James Walker Evans and dates release September19. Woodward signed the release statement for the fifteen; the identified exceptions Jones/Taylor stayed until September29. Separate September episode; preserve Woodward July case.
